text:
# filter.expiresAtAfter

TL;DR:
- filter.expiresAtAfter matches listings expiring after a given timestamp.

What it means:
- It adds a lower expiration-time bound to the query.

Agent hint:
- Use it when the workflow wants listings that will remain available beyond a known time horizon.
